english:
Swords are granted 30|53|60 Charge Rate with one, two, or three mods equipped.

Glaive Projectile Hits grant 20%|30%|35% increased Weapon Energy. This stacks additively with Immovable Object.

source.text:
Swords are granted +30 | +53 | +60 Charge Rate.

Glaive Projectile Hits grant 20% | 30% | 35% Increased Weapon Energy. 
Stacks additively with Immovable Object.
